scripts.script:
local Library = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xHeptc/Kavo-UI-Library/main/source.lua"))()

local Window = Library.CreateLib("🚽✨[EP 66!] Skibidi Toilet Tower Defense", "DarkTheme")

local Tab = Window:NewTab("BY ROBLOXSCRIPTSYT2")

local Section = Tab:NewSection("SECOND SCRIPT")

local Tab = Window:NewTab("MAIN")

local Section = Tab:NewSection("ALL UNITS")

Section:NewButton("Holy", "ButtonInfo", function() local function getHeadPosition() local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer local character = player.Character if character then local humanoid = character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") if humanoid then local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head") if head then return head.Position end end end return nil end

local headPosition = getHeadPosition() if headPosition then local A_1 = "Holy" local A_2 = CFrame.new(headPosition) local Event = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Functions.SpawnTower Event:InvokeServer(A_1, A_2) end

end)
